request.state: I drove to the regional office and back for the planning meeting, claiming mileage at the standard rate for forty two miles round trip.

q1.instructions: This expense claim needs a receipt attached before it can be paid.

criteria.true: The claim is for more than 25 pounds, or it is for anything bought from an outside supplier whatever the amount.
criteria.false: The claim is mileage at the fixed rate per mile, a per-day subsistence allowance at the fixed rate, or anything under 25 pounds that is not from an outside supplier.
